acceptanceCriteria: A ProcessFailure shows the CLI's first stderr line, sanitised and bounded like other displayed text, with a test.
body: Found by the 2026-09-27 adapter audit for rc.2. extensions/vscode/src/extension.ts:740-750 inertError maps every ProcessFailure to '<code>: local Corvint process failed' and drops the CLI's bounded stderr reason, so users see no actionable cause (for example unsupported root or stale index).
